scope: editing semantics and Timeline single source of truth
frontend interaction, accessibility and responsive layout
local HTTP, SSE, filesystem and MCP security
test strategy, documentation truth and completion integrity

findings.problem: Window resize before opening a Timeline dereferenced a null projection.
findings.fix: The overlay renderer clears transient layers and returns before accessing editor metadata.
findings.evidence: real browser reload/resize with zero console errors

findings.problem: At 390px the toolbar compressed Chinese labels into vertical characters.
findings.fix: Tool groups no longer shrink and button labels remain on one line inside a horizontal scroller.

findings.problem: Waveform cache and same-key deduplication did not bound distinct concurrent FFmpeg processes.
findings.fix: Added a global two-process limit with structured 429 backpressure and a parallel negative test.

findings.problem: Expired or evicted editor sessions did not explicitly close SSE clients.
findings.fix: Centralized session disposal closes event responses, clears client sets and removes the session.

findings.problem: A valid in-project media index could point at a strong-identity asset outside the project root and return its path.
findings.fix: Project Bin excludes all realpaths outside its project root and reports the excluded count; replacement cannot resolve them.
findings.evidence: synthetic outside-root index item negative test

findings.problem: The installed runtime bundle excludes website/, while Studio loaded its logo from website/public.
findings.fix: Studio now serves the byte-identical bundled assets/brand logo; distribution tests forbid the excluded path.
findings.evidence: bundle filter review and distribution test

findings.problem: New Workbench and MCP user-facing surfaces used an incorrect Chinese product name.
findings.fix: Normalized all new titles, labels, diagnostics and metadata to 咔嚓.
findings.evidence: repository search and browser title/brand review

findings.problem: MCP timeline query reported truncated when match count exactly equaled the requested limit.
findings.fix: Compute the complete bounded match set before slicing and set truncated only when matches exceed the limit.

findings.problem: The secret scanner treated a long repository-relative evidence filename as a high-entropy secret.
findings.fix: Exempt only known repository path prefixes from the entropy heuristic; credential pattern checks remain active.
findings.evidence: secret scan pass and installer negative boundaries

findings.problem: A static regression asserted the previous null-guard source literal instead of the safety behavior.
findings.fix: Updated the contract assertion to the new explicit null guard and reran the affected test plus full suite.

dimensionResults.note: High-value correction, provenance and activation paths are implemented without broad NLE parity scope.
Structural edits remain explicit and reversible; executed transitions block unsafe reorder/split.
Editor metadata preserves graph digest while x/y keyframes change and successfully render through FFmpeg.
Desktop and 390px real-browser journeys are operable, responsive and console-clean after fixes.
Loopback/origin/session, closed tool schemas, root confinement, bounded body/concurrency and secret scan gates pass.
Project Bin revalidates identity/license/provenance; rhythm evidence cannot bypass reference rights or originality.
Current discovery and legacy initialize fixtures pass over protocol-only stdio.
Client helpers, offline demo, installer rehearsal and bundle composition pass; local synchronization follows this review.
Locally solvable work is complete; independent review, real creator acceptance, CI/remote delivery and registry publication remain external.
